subject: URGENT: shipment held pending approval
body: A freight shipment bound for our regional distribution center has been held at customs. This is urgent because the cargo includes temperature-sensitive goods that will spoil by end of week. Please review the attached status report and confirm the release today. The warehouse team is on standby. If we miss this window the order will be void and the client will invoice us for the loss. Reply immediately with your approval so we can proceed.
indicators: requests immediate reply outside normal process
hook: Uses a plausible logistics pain point and a financial-loss threat that would pressure an operations employee to act fast.
